editor.rateStored: The rate is stored on the document so it stays reproducible.
editor.noLinesBody: Add a product or service, or create a one-off line.
editor.otherChargesHint: Freight, packing or installation added to the total.
editor.otherChargesTaxedHint: Freight, packing or installation. Spread over the items and taxed at their GST rates.
editor.roundOffHint: Rounds the grand total to the nearest whole unit and shows the adjustment.
editor.reverseChargeBillHint: You pay this GST to the government yourself, not to the supplier. Used for transport (GTA), legal services and other notified supplies.
editor.reverseChargeSaleHint: The buyer pays this GST to the government. The invoice shows it but doesn’t charge it.
editor.noteReasonHint: Printed on the note and reported with it.
editor.notesHint: Visible to the customer on the document
editor.zeroValueLines: Rate and amount must be more than 0. Fix: {{names}}
editor.zeroTotal: The total must be more than 0.
editor.dateBeforeSource: Can't be before {{date}}, the date of {{kind}} {{number}}
editor.posHint: Decides whether IGST or CGST + SGST applies
editor.partySearch: Search your contacts or add a new one
editor.roundOffAmountHint: Enter a negative value to round down, e.g. -0.40.
editor.roundOffTooLarge: Round-off must be less than {{amount}} either way.
editor.linesMissingHsn: HSN/SAC is required on every line of a GST invoice. Missing on: {{names}}
editor.insufficientStock: Not enough stock on {{date}}: {{names}}. Add stock or allow negative stock in settings.
editor.itemOutOfStockBlocked: {{name}} is out of stock at this branch. Add stock, or turn on “Allow negative stock” in company settings.
editor.creditLimitExceeded: {{party}} has a credit limit of {{limit}}. With this invoice they would owe {{exposure}}.
editor.exportIgstHint: Export or SEZ supply — IGST applies. Add an LUT in the business profile to zero-rate it.
editor.exportLutHint: Export or SEZ supply under LUT — zero-rated, no IGST charged.
editor.importHint: Import from abroad — no GST on the supplier's bill (IGST is paid at customs).
editor.itemBeforeOpeningStock: {{name}}'s opening stock is dated {{date}}. Date this document {{date}} or later to add it.
editor.dateBeforeOpeningStock: Can't be before {{date}}, the opening stock date of {{name}}
editor.beforeDocDate: Can't be before the document date, {{date}}
editor.defaultTerms: Goods once sold will not be taken back. Interest @18% p.a. on overdue amounts.
editor.finaliseNote: Finalising assigns a permanent number that is never reused. Drafts can still be edited freely.
editor.finaliseNoteStock: Finalising assigns a permanent number that is never reused and posts stock movements for tracked items. Drafts can still be edited freely.
editor.taxMixed: Some lines include tax and some don’t. Pick one to set them all.
editor.saveAndSendHint: Finalise, then email it to the customer
editor.bankNone: No bank account on your invoices yet.
editor.bankUpiQr: UPI QR for the total prints on the invoice

noteGst.label: GST treatment
noteGst.withGstHint: Adjusts the GST of one earlier supply: give its number and date. It goes to GSTR-1, and a credit note must be issued by 30 November after that invoice’s financial year.
noteGst.noGstHint: A commercial discount or adjustment with no GST: no tax on any line, posted to discount, and left out of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.

reimburse.title: {{count}} billable expenses to recover
reimburse.body: Add them at cost as reimbursements: no GST, outside the taxable value (Rule 33).
reimburse.creditClaimed: Credit of {{tax}} was claimed on this expense. A pure agent recovers a cost paid in the customer’s name, without claiming its credit.

detail.nothingLeftBody: This document is in its final state.
detail.deleteDraftMessage: Drafts are not numbered, so nothing is left behind. This cannot be undone.
detail.cancelMessage: The number stays reserved and the document is kept for your audit trail, but it no longer counts towards your books.
detail.cancelEwayFirst: Cancel e-way bill {{number}} before cancelling this document
detail.cancelIrnFirst: Cancel the e-invoice (IRN) before cancelling this document
detail.pdfFailed: Could not generate the PDF on this device

editBlock.periodLocked: Can't edit: the books are closed for its date
editBlock.hasPayments: Can't edit: a payment is allocated to it
editBlock.hasCredit: Can't edit: a credit note is adjusted against it
editBlock.hasNotes: Can't edit: a return or note stands against it
editBlock.eInvoiced: Can't edit: it has an IRN (e-invoice)
editBlock.ewayBill: Can't edit: it has an e-way bill
editBlock.returnFiled: Can't edit: its GSTR-1 month is filed
editBlock.laterStock: Can't edit: its stock has moved since (FIFO)

detail.editIssuedKind: An issued {{kind, lowercase}} can't be changed. Duplicate it to start again, or cancel it.

line.inclusiveHint: Turn on when the price you quote already contains tax.
line.nameRequired: Enter a name for this line
line.quantityTooHigh: Cannot exceed {{max}}, the quantity on the original document
line.discountTooHigh: The discount takes this line to 0. Lower the discount.
line.removeMessage: {{name}} comes off the document, with its quantity, rate and discount.

payment.fxHint: A rate different from the invoice rate produces an FX gain or loss.
payment.advanceHint: This payment will be held as an advance against the contact.
payment.adjustReceived: Customer deducted TDS, or a discount or write-off
payment.adjustPaid: You deducted TDS, or got a discount

adjustmentHint.tdsDeducted: Settles the invoice with no money moving; claimed back against Form 26AS.
adjustmentHint.discount: Settles the rest at a discount, such as for prompt payment.
adjustmentHint.writeOff: What won’t be paid, booked as a bad debt.

payment.serviceAdvanceHint: GST is due on an advance for services when it is received; the invoice raised later takes it back. Advances for goods carry none.
payment.advanceTaxIs: GST on the advance: {{tax}}, inside the amount received
payment.advanceBody: Nothing was allocated, so the full amount sits against the contact.
payment.deleteMessage: Any invoice it was applied to will go back to being outstanding. This cannot be undone.
payment.noAccountForMethod: No account matches this payment method
payment.addAccount: Add a bank or wallet account
payment.advanceAvailableHint: Adjust earlier advances against the open documents below.
payment.nothingLeftToApply: All of it is applied. Increase the amount first
payment.unallocatedNote: {{amount}} is unallocated and available as an advance.
payment.tdsSectionHint: The TDS kept back here is reported under this section in 26Q and TDS payable.
payment.advanceTdsHint: Kept back from this advance; it credits them as money does.
payment.advanceGoods: That is goods: an advance for goods carries no GST
payment.deleteMessagePaid: Any bill it was applied to will go back to being outstanding. This cannot be undone.
payment.editHint: The amount and what it settles stay as recorded. To change them, delete this payment and record it again.
payment.tdsSectionRequired: Pick the TDS section to save

aging.reminderNote: The message is prepared for you — you send it yourself, so nothing leaves the app without your say-so.
aging.reminderMessage_one: Hi {{name}}, a gentle reminder that invoice {{numbers}} totalling {{amount}} is still open. Could you let us know when payment is planned? Thank you.
aging.reminderMessage_other: Hi {{name}}, a gentle reminder that invoices {{numbers}} totalling {{amount}} are still open. Could you let us know when payment is planned? Thank you.

list.emptyBody: Record one to see it here.

print.pdfFailed: Could not generate the PDF on this device

pdf.scanToPay: Scan to pay with any UPI app

returnPicker.salesHint: Pick the invoice being returned. Its lines are copied into the return, where you can reduce quantities or remove lines.
returnPicker.purchaseHint: Pick the bill being returned. Its lines are copied into the return, where you can reduce quantities or remove lines.
returnPicker.linesHint: Untick the lines this doesn't cover. You can still change quantities and amounts in the draft.

hint.creditNote: Pick the invoice this credit note lowers. Its lines are copied in: change them to the amount being credited, such as the discount or the price difference.
hint.debitNote: Pick the invoice this debit note adds to. Its lines are copied in: change them to the extra amount being charged.
hint.supplierCreditNote: Pick the supplier’s bill their credit note is against, then enter it as they issued it.
hint.supplierDebitNote: Pick the supplier’s bill their debit note is against, then enter it as they issued it.

directHint.invoice: For a discount over a period or a rate change that isn't against one invoice. You give the reason on the note.
directHint.bill: For a supplier's note that isn't against one of their bills. You give the reason on the note.

orPick.invoice: Or raise it against an invoice
orPick.bill: Or raise it against a bill

refund.title: Refund the advance
refund.subtitle: Out of {{number}}: {{amount}} still held
refund.tooMuch: Only {{amount}} of the advance is left
refund.beforeReceipt: A refund can't be dated before the advance was received
refund.hint: The refund prints as the refund voucher (Rule 51). On an advance for services, the GST paid on what is refunded comes back in the month of the refund.
refund.emptyTitle: Paid back out of an advance
refund.emptyBody: A refund settles no invoices: it returns part of the advance the customer paid.

grid.enterHint: Enter moves down a column; on the last line it adds an item.

recurring.title: Repeat this invoice
recurring.hint: A copy is issued on each date of the series, with the same customer, lines and prices, and its own number. It is e-invoiced like any other.
recurring.autoSendHint: Sends it to the customer as soon as it is issued.

approval.title: Waiting for approval
approval.pendingBody: Sent for approval on {{date}}. An owner or admin approves it, which issues it, or sends it back.
approval.rejectedBody: An owner or admin sent this back: {{note}}. Change it and issue it again.
approval.emptyBody: Documents and payments over the amounts set in Settings → Approvals wait here for an owner or admin.

tcs.hint: For sales of scrap, minerals, timber and similar goods, or vehicles and luxury goods over ₹10 lakh.

tds.hint: If this customer deducts TDS from what they pay you, pick the section: the invoice total stays the same.
tds.willDeduct: The customer is expected to deduct {{amount}} and pay {{net}}
tds.rateHint: Worked on the value before GST. Leave empty for the section's rate.
